breaker.condition: a managed configuration still activates envsitter-guard, opencode-mem, oh-my-opencode, or oh-my-openagent

acceptance_criteria: profiles/default/links.json contains no link targeting oh-my-opencode.json or opencode-mem.jsonc under ~/.config/opencode
